License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see FONT-AWESOME-OFL-1.1.txt.

Extraction: Original SVG-font glyph outlines are unchanged. Each glyph is
packaged as a standalone inline SVG with its original horizontal advance,
units-per-em, and ascent; a translate/vertical flip converts font coordinates
to SVG coordinates. No complete renamed font is distributed.
The font-derived artwork retains its OFL license; the licenses do not require
the surrounding website or documents to adopt OFL.

The source projects' READMEs distinguish the font's SIL OFL 1.1 license from
the CSS MIT license and the documentation CC BY 3.0 license. Only glyph
outlines are embedded here; source CSS and documentation are not included.
